title: Question register row (XR)
description: One row of books/<client>/06-questions/register.md. The register is the source; reports are derived from it. Severity is set by the register owner only. Anything arriving by email enters at grade A.

title.description: The answer, as one sentence a reader with no context could act on. Not a topic label. Carries the grade when rendered.

description.description: 2–4 sentences: what, since when, where, to whom

severity.description: 1 harm occurring or imminent · 2 material impact within the cycle · 3 managed within the function · 4 watch. Set by the register owner only; sender proposals go in notes.

trend.description: Tracks the path to close, not the latest measure

owner.description: One accountable person or role. Never a team

slip_count.description: Successive moves to a later date; flag at 2

grade.description: Grade of the title sentence. Email enters at A. Rises only when a measure or producible artifact is named.

source.description: Thread subject and date, message id, or ledger file of the last update

would_change_the_answer.description: The observation that would move title, severity or trend. Required for Sev 1–2; 'open' otherwise until known

hypotheses_ref.description: Path to the hypothesis table for this row, if opened

answer_card_ref.description: Path to the filed answer card in knowledge/, once answered

notes.description: Sender severity proposals, precedence overrides, SLIP flags, artifacts that would raise the grade
